visual.general_description: Line graph of breast milk paclitaxel concentration against time.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background line graph with a vertical axis labelled Paclitaxel concentration (ng/mL) with ticks from 0 to 200 in steps of 20 and a horizontal axis labelled Time (h) with ticks from 0 to 80 in steps of 5. One series of filled black circle markers is joined by a solid black line. The series starts at the origin, rises steeply to a single maximum early on the time axis, then falls through several markers and flattens close to the baseline for the remainder of the time axis, with the last markers at the right end of the series. There is no legend, title, panel letter or printed data label.

visual.general_description: Line graph comparing maternal plasma and breast milk paclitaxel concentrations over time.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background line graph with a vertical axis labelled Paclitaxel concentration (ng/mL) with ticks from 0 to 2500 in steps of 500 and a horizontal axis labelled Time (h) with ticks from 0 to 80 in steps of 5. A legend at the upper right lists Maternal plasma with a dotted line and filled circle marker, and Breast milk with a solid line and filled circle marker. The plasma series rises almost vertically near the origin to a tall narrow peak and falls almost as steeply; the breast milk series stays far lower on the same axis and trails along the horizontal axis to the right end of the plotted points. There is no title or panel letter and no printed data label.
